0022600193.text: The Warriors (5-3, riding a five-game win streak) sit 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 8th in the West, going 3-1 at home. The Magic (2-5, on a two-game losing streak) are 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 12th in the East, with a 0-4 home record. Golden State is without Gui Santos, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, and Moses Moody, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Paolo Banchero. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors won the last meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
